projectTitle: Parkinson disease BA9 brain versus neurologically normal control brain
contrastDefinition: Parkinson disease BA9 postmortem brain tissue versus neurologically normal control BA9 tissue
sampleGroupSource: Parsed from GEO sample titles (`C_*` controls, `P_*` Parkinson disease) together with GEO sample characteristics.
batchHandlingRule: DESeq2 design = ~ post_mortem_interval_pmi + age_at_death + rna_integrity_number_rin + group; no additional batch factor.
notes: Primary mental/neural manuscript cohort. Uses NCBI-generated raw counts and GEO series metadata.
